Dec Corn futures closed the session at a one month high of 434'0 Wednesday, up by 2'0. Overall the session saw 503,880 contracts done, with Dec volume coming in at 239,879. Total open interest decreased by 20,920, or 1.28%, to end the session with 1,616,987 outstanding. The Dec maturity fell by 3.58% (20,920) to finish at 689,689.

The Jan 425 put saw the most changing hands with 10,047 contracts done. Options with the largest open interest are the Dec 450 call with 35,383, and the Dec 400 put with 59,946.

As measured by CVL, implied volatility ended the session sharply higher, up by 1.4 to finish the day at a one month high of 20.93. Historical volatility (30-day) finished the day at 12.85%, lower by 0.11%. The CVL Skew ended the session moderately down, off by 0.43 to settle at 0.84.

Option volumes were greatest for the Dec 430 call (17,021) and the Dec 420 put (15,829). Option open interest is greatest for the Dec 450 calls at 36,594, and the Dec 400 puts at 62,436.

The Dec 415 put saw the most changing hands with 14,019 contracts done. Option open interest is highest for the Dec 430 calls at 37,981, and the Dec 400 puts at 66,341.
